tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i brgyud 'debs thugs rje mkha' khyab bzhugs so// 1$0000300kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas chos kyi sku /padma rgyal po rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs// rigs drug 'gro 'dul mtsho skyes sprul sku la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /rdo rje btsun mo gsang 'dzin mkhar chen bza'// 'jig rten mgon po spang ston chos kyi dbang*// 'ja' 'od skur gshegs ma ṇi rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan seng ge'i sgra /thugs rje che dngos dpal ldan kaḥthog pa// snang bzhi mthar phyin tshul khrims 'bum pa la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /theg dgu'i chos mdzod 'bum gyi sgo 'byed mgon// mkhas shing grub brnyes bu 'bor ye shes mtshan// phyogs med 'gro 'dul byang sems chos rje la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /shes rab gsum dang dbang phyug brgyad kyi mdzod// mnga' bdag thugs sprul paṇa chen padma dbang*/ rig 'dzin grub mchog karma gu ru la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /bdud kyi g.yul 'joms blo gros rgyal mtshan 'dzin// chos kun dbang 'byor dri med ye shes can// gsang bdag dpa' bo phrin las lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /bka' gter shing rta chos rgyal gter bdag gling*// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rin chen rnam par rgyal// bslab gsum dbang phyug āo ḍī ya na la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /gsang chen phri~Xn la~Xs spel mdzad rnama~X rgyala~X mtshan// pa~Xdma~Xs byin brlabs dba~Xng bzhi'i rgyala~X thabs 'chang*// sangs rgyas bstan skyong kun dga'i 'dren mchog la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /'ja~Xm dpal dbya~Xngs dngos mkhye~Xn nus brtse~X ba'i dbang*// smin grol bcud sbyin rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje mkha' khyab shog /'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba'i gding thob cing*// stong nyid snying rje sgom gyi rtsal chen rdzogs// mkha' khyab 'gro sgrol spyod pa mthar phyin te// 'jig rten mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /
ces pa 'di'ang yig drug pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis sgrub thabs mdzes rgyan du bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
